assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied Yao guai cartoon creature sprite. Keep its exact left-facing four-legged bear pose, proportions, head shape, paws, claws, red eye, snarl, bold dark outlines and simple Fallout Shelter flat cel shading. Change the hide and fur only: remove approximately 85% of the thick fluffy fur, especially the huge mane across shoulders, neck and back. Replace it with mostly bare sickly gray-pink wrinkled skin, muted ashen brown discoloration, patchy dark scabs and small stylized decaying lesions. Show subtly sunken flanks and skin folds to convey a diseased irradiated bear, while retaining massive bear shoulders. Only a few sparse ragged dark fur tufts remain along the spine and ears. A sick, mangy, rotting wasteland Yao guai rather than a healthy shaggy fantasy bear. Keep decay stylized and readable: no graphic exposed organs or blood spray, no intricate realistic gore. Preserve genuinely transparent alpha, complete silhouette, all four paws and generous clear margins. No scenery, floor, shadow, haze, glow, text, watermark, extra creature or accessories.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete Fallout MIRELURK creature sprite for a Fallout Shelter style game. Supplied images are style references only: match bold dark outlines, broad flat cel-shaded shapes, chunky proportions, simple two-to-three tone shading, readable small UI silhouette. Creature: recognizable Fallout 4 crab-type Mirelurk, huge domed weathered brown-olive shell arching over its back, a small recessed crustacean face protected under the front shell rim, two massive articulated front arms ending in asymmetrical crab pincers, two heavy bent supporting legs with pointed crab feet and small auxiliary crustacean appendages beneath torso. Hunched upright crab monster posture, not an ordinary low beach crab or a turtle. Rust-brown shell plates with restrained cream highlights, muted gray-green limbs and a few subtle barnacle clusters. Full body in a grounded battle-ready stance, facing LEFT in slight three-quarter side view, both pincers and both supporting feet readable. Entire silhouette visible, modest clear margins, centered and fills most canvas. Actual transparent alpha background. No scenery, floor, cast shadow, glow, haze, text, watermark, weapons, extra creatures or loose pieces. Match reference simplification, avoid photoreal textures.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete Fallout RADSTAG creature sprite for a Fallout Shelter style game.
